title: You don't have to earn rest (chai in the rain, pause reel)

captions.instagram:
You don't have to earn rest. ☕🌧️

Not after the inbox is empty. Not after everyone else has eaten.
Ten minutes with a cup of chai and the rain counts too.
Your phone can stay face down for a while.

Send this to someone who never stops.

#rest #selfcare #slowliving #emotionalwellness #soundmind
